pdf.js 6.3.289 (Apache-2.0, see LICENSE), self-hosted so the site makes no request outside its own origin.
Added in commit 41e07a3. The package it comes from is pdfjs-dist; this copy was not compared with the registry when this note was written (2026-11-04).
Files: pdf.min.mjs, pdf.worker.min.mjs. Their sha256 are in test/fixtures/vendor-sha256.json, and test/vendor.test.mjs fails if one changes.
To update: replace the files, rewrite this note, run node scripts/vendor-manifest.mjs and npm test.
